No. 1754 of 2022 ----- Sanjay Raut, aged about 53 years, son of Bishwanath Raut, resident of Minerva Press, Sri Ram Para Dumka, P.O. Dumka, P.S.Dumka, District- Dumka, Jharkhand ..... ... Opposite Parties -------- Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi ------ For the Petitioners : Mr.Indrajit Sinha, Advocate Mr. Rishav Kumar, Advocate. For the State : Mr. P.D.Agarwal, Spl.P.P. ------ Sanjay Raut vs The State Of Jharkhand on 21 December, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18450228/ 1 03/ 21.12.2022 These petitions have been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 12.03.2020, passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dumka, in connection with Complaint (Ocr) Case No. 664/2020 and Complaint (Ocr) Case No.667 of 2020, respectively, by which, cognizance for the offence under Section 3(1)(ZZ)(viii) of Food Safety and Standard Act, has been taken against the petitioner, pending in that court.
texts.facts: These petitions have been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 12.03.2020, passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dumka, in connection with Complaint (Ocr) Case No. 664/2020 and Complaint (Ocr) Case No.667 of 2020, respectively, by which, cognizance for the offence under Section 3(1)(ZZ)(viii) of Food Safety and Standard Act, has been taken against the petitioner, pending in that court.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that Section 3(1)(ZZ)(viii) of Food Safety and Standard Act is a definition section with regard to the said Act. He submits that the penal provision is Section 59 of the said Act.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that Section 3(1)(ZZ)(viii) of Food Safety and Standard Act is a definition section with regard to the said Act. He submits that the penal provision is Section 59 of the said Act.
